plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Proxim wireless device. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 841).
name: Wireless

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the wireless device since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Proxim wireless device (sysMonitorCPUUsage, OID 841.1.1.3.9.1). The vendor exposes a DisplayString percentage which is parsed to a 0-100 numeric gauge. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate heavy client-association load, control-plane pressure, or RF management overhead affecting roaming and management responsiveness.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Proxim wireless device (sysMonitorRAMUsage, OID 841.1.1.3.9.2). The vendor exposes a DisplayString percentage which is parsed to a 0-100 numeric gauge. High memory pressure can cause the access point to drop client associations or restart services, so investigate client counts or abnormal load promptly.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Internal unit temperature in degrees Celsius of the Proxim wireless device (currentUnitTemp, OID 841.1.1.3.8.1), read directly with no scaling. Optional: if the device does not respond the field is omitted and not faked. High temperatures can indicate cooling failure or poor airflow and risk thermal shutdown.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of total bytes received by the entire wireless device over the past 5 minutes, summed across all interfaces from the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of total bytes sent by the entire wireless device over the past 5 minutes, summed across all interfaces from the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter.
